s.t: ← Back to the game Short version. The full page with every detail stays at Rules ; every date and old rule is in Rule history . XCPETS is a Counterparty token on Bitcoin. You play by burning XCPETS with a short tag. Each burn is a Bitcoin transaction you sign in your own wallet; it also pays a small Bitcoin network fee (in sats). Anyone can rebuild the game from the chain: same burns, same result, no server. Dander: 1 dander = 0.00000001 XCPETS. Amounts are what a burn costs now. A Fire Sale cuts them further. A Fire Sale is 31% for 36 blocks.

pet:hatch 8.625 · one egg. pet:hatch12 86.25 · 12 eggs. pet:hatch144 862.5 · 144 eggs. pet:hatchzap 12,500 · 1,000 Electric Eggs (better tier odds). Species, tier and looks come from the block hash and your tx id, so nobody knows them in advance. Paying less hatches nothing (it feeds the community pet).

One meal a day per pet (a day = 144 blocks). Meal: 517.5 / 862.5 / 1,207.5 / 1,150 by stage. Only the owner can feed; Mythics don’t eat. Feed all is one burn: pet:fr:AA:RUNS , the exact total of the meals. Single pet: pet:feed:ID . WAGMI : pet:wagmi , 1 dander, once a day keeps your 🔥 streak. The first 5 wallets each day get +1 saved spin. 🧹 Daily chores (new, from block 974,163): pet:dc:F[:AA:RUNS] does WAGMI + Feed all + use all saved spins in one burn. Cost = the meals (at least 1 dander). Each part is skipped on its own if there is nothing to do. Stages: Hatchling → Juvenile (day 2) → Adult (day 4) → Elder (day 6) → Mythic (day 9). Once you raise a Mythic yourself, your other pets reach Mythic at 21,000 care.

Every pet has 6 open slots: Headwear, Grip, Armor, Drip, Guise, Ride. pet:spin 43.125 · picks one of your pets (Legendary 8 times as likely as Common) and puts a new piece on it. Saved spins come from lucky drops (25% per stage-up, 2% per meal), Fire Sales, Mythic overflow and raids. From block 974,279 they land only on pets you pick: Pick pets for your spins in the Rare Room ( pet:ut , only the Bitcoin fee). Before that block each spin went to a random living pet of yours, never-fed and discarded pets included. Looks: pet:look:ID:CODE:on|off , 1 dander, up to 6 changes per burn.

Fight : pet:fight:A:B, accepted with pet:accept:N. The loser can lose one worn piece (★ signature pieces are never taken). Breed : pet:breed:A:B 16.875 (Adult or older, 6 breeds per pet, 1,008 blocks between breeds). Two owners: both pay 16.875 . Raid : pet:raid:ID, 8.625 or more, once per pet per day. Damage = amount times pet bonus (1.00 to 1.50) times crit (1, 2 or 3 times). Rewards only if the boss falls. Quest : pet:quest:ID:Q sends a Mythic away for loot.
Tie a pet to its own Counterparty token ( pet:deed:ID:ASSET , 1 dander). Whoever holds the token owns the pet: gift = send the token, sell = a DEX order.

A pet that is never fed dies and gets a grave. From block 977,026, a pet that has been dead for 14 game days leaves. Legendary and Mythic pets stay. So do rare species (the limited ones, not a normal Pepe and not just a Rare tier), hybrids, special pets (1 of 1s, contest prizes, burn lords, grants, tokenized pets, jackpot pets, and Legend hatches), and weird hatches (tiny, giant, two-headed, inverted, ghost, backwards, and wrong egg). An Electric Egg is not spared for being an Electric Egg. A burn aimed at a pet that has left only feeds the community pet. Graves can be raised as zombies; a zombie can be resurrected (Resurrection) or, if it is a starving zombie, unleashed on one of your Mythics ( pet:unleash:ID ) to try for a Mythic God (21 Pantheon seats ever).

Every burn, and any burn that breaks a rule, feeds the shared community pet, the community pet . When it reaches Mythic it goes to Cold Storage, the next one arrives, and 6 blocks later every cost halves once more. Captain Dan calls Fire Sales from lucky blocks: 6 blocks of warning, then 36 blocks at 31%.

Randomness comes only from block hashes and tx ids. Burns count in chain order, once confirmed. A burn that breaks a rule is not refunded; it feeds the community pet. Every new rule starts at a stated block, so older burns always replay the same. ← Back to the game · Rules (exact costs, tags, odds) · Pet Guide 🎓 New here? Take the The Big Beautiful Tutorial : a short guided tour with practice demos. Or let Coach Peepo show you around the Play page. XCPETS is a burn-to-play pet game on Bitcoin. Every action is a real burn (a Counterparty destroy ) of XCPETS that you sign in your own XCP Wallet. There's no server and no account. The game rebuilds everyone's pets from the public burn history, so every player sees the same result. The Rules page has the exact tags, odds and edge cases. Don't take our word for it: 🔎 Verify it yourself shows any pet's burn, block hash and seed, and replays the whole game in your browser.

Install the XCP Wallet extension on desktop Chrome. Play on your phone: open xcpets.fun inside the Casa Tookan app, which signs burns the same way. Get some XCPETS on xcp.fun , plus a little BTC for network fees, into that wallet. Press Connect XCP Wallet on Play. Before every burn the game shows the amount, the tag and the Bitcoin fee, then XCP Wallet asks for your final approval. Nothing burns unless you approve both. Disconnect forgets the address on this site. Hatch an egg, and feed it the same day. Feed it every day. Roll gear for any of its 6 slots. Battle from Juvenile, breed from Adult.

Action XCPETS Hatch one egg / a dozen (12) / a case (144) 17.25 / 172.5 / 1,725 Feed one meal (Hatchling / Juvenile / Adult / Elder) 1,035 / 1,725 / 2,415 / 2,300 Raise a pet all the way to Mythic 17,267.25 in total Gear roll 86.25 Battle: challenge + accept 172.5 + 172.5 Breed (+ 33.75 from the partner's owner if it isn't your pet) 33.75 Feed the community pet 17.25 / 172.5 / 1,725 Community gear roll 172.5 Release a pet, or use up to 10 saved Pepe Wheel spins 0.00000001 Discard a pet free (no burn) Amounts are what a burn costs now: the base amount divided by 4 after 2 halvings. A Fire Sale cuts them further. A halving halves every burn amount (the first came 6 blocks after Lord Kek reached Mythic, then one 6 blocks after each later community pet goes to Cold Storage). During a Fire Sale every burn costs 31% of the usual amount, on top of any halving. Details are in the Rules . Halvings so far: 2. The next one comes 6 blocks after Homer Pepe goes to Cold Storage. Every burn is also a Bitcoin transaction with a small BTC network fee.

Crack One Open, a Crack Pack (12) or a Yolk Booster Box (144). From block 972,992 the ⚡ Electric Shock Box hatches 1,000 Electric Eggs in one burn with boosted odds (Legendary 8%, Rare 22%, Uncommon 40%, Common 30%; details ). A pack is a single burn, so it's cheaper per egg and you pay one Bitcoin fee instead of many. The Bitcoin block your burn lands in decides each pet's species, rarity (Common, Uncommon, Rare or Legendary) and looks, so nobody can pick or predict them. Rarer species only hatch at rarer tiers; Nakamotos are no longer hatched; existing ones are kept. The 1 in 777 egg is now a FUNTRUMP egg. When Homer Pepe reaches Mythic and goes to Cold Storage, FUNTRUMP eggs stop and that 1 in 777 egg becomes a Homer Pepe egg. There is no other way to get either one. The odds are in the Pet Guide . After the burn confirms, a reveal shows your new pets.

A hatched pet starts as a Hatchling . Bred babies start as an Egg and need a 17.25 XCPETS meal to hatch. Only the pet's owner can feed it, once a day (a day is 144 Bitcoin blocks). Each feed costs that stage's meal: 1,035 (Hatchling), 1,725 (Juvenile), 2,415 (Adult), 2,300 (Elder). Burn less and the feed doesn't count; burn more and the extra only feeds the community pet. The Play page fills in the exact amount. Care moves the pet through Hatchling → Juvenile → Adult → Elder → Mythic . Fed every day, a pet turns Mythic on its own after 9 meals (about 9 days, 69,069 care). Feeding on consecutive days builds your pet's feed streak (and badges). Your WAGMI streak is separate: see Rankings. Feed all hungry on Play feeds the hungry pets you own that can still eat. It is usually one burn, pet:fr , for the exact total of their meals. Mythic pets do not eat, and a pet away on a quest is left out. If the herd does not fit in one tag, it splits into as few pet:fr burns as needed. One pet is pet:feed:ID . Pets whose numbers sit close together can share a pet:fm window when that is fewer burns. Feed selected does the same for the pets you tick. The old one-burn tag pet:fa was retired at block 974,163: a pet:fa burn now only feeds the community pet, and the feed-skip list is retired with it. Discarded pets are left out of the feeds the site plans. Details in the Rules . Mythic shortcut: once you raise a Mythic yourself, your other pets only need 21,000 care to turn Mythic. Raised means you hatched, bred or were granted it and it never left you, or you fed it more than half of its care yourself. A Mythic you were gifted, swapped for or bought (shop or token) doesn't count, and neither does a pet you got close to Mythic and fed once or twice; exactly half isn't enough. A pet already past 21,000 then earns one free saved Pepe Wheel spin for every full 1,000 care above 21,000.

From the 3rd day after its last meal, a pet is neglected : it can't battle or breed. After 7 full days with no meal, it dies . The clock starts at hatch if a pet was never fed. From block 977,026, a pet that has been dead for 14 game days leaves the game. A game day is 144 blocks. The pause from block 975,817 to 976,518 does not count. Legendary and Mythic pets stay. So do rare species (the limited ones, not a normal Pepe and not just a Rare tier), hybrids, special pets (1 of 1s, contest prizes, burn lords, grants, tokenized pets, jackpot pets, and Legend hatches), and weird hatches (tiny, giant, two-headed, inverted, ghost, backwards, and wrong egg). An Electric Egg is not spared for being an Electric Egg. A burn aimed at a pet that has left only feeds the community pet. The full list is in the Rules . A dead pet moves to the Pet Cemetery . Its gear goes back to the owner's stash. Mythic pets never starve. Play and each pet's page warn you when a pet is close to starving.

Pets wear gear in six slots: Headwear, Grip, Armor, Drip, Guise, Ride . From block 973,560 every pet has all 6 gear slots open , whatever its age, feeding, tier or stage (new pets too). (Before that block, a new pet had 1 open and more opened as it got older and stayed fed.) Rarity doesn't change how many slots a pet has, but it does cap how rare the gear it rolls can be. A gear roll ( 86.25 ) is a Pepe Wheel spin : it picks one of your living pets at random (rarer pets are picked more often: Common 1, Uncommon 2, Rare 4, Legendary 8) and puts the new piece straight on that pet. From block 972,646 a roll can land in any of the 6 slots . Before block 973,560, pieces for a slot the pet hadn't opened waited in its bag 🎒; at that block every slot opens and bagged pieces are worn (or go to the stash if that slot is already filled). The bag belongs to that pet and is lost with it. Lucky drops 🎟️: every stage-up has a 25% chance, and every other meal a 2% chance, to drop one free saved Pepe Wheel spin . Use saved spins from the Rare Room, up to 10 in one tiny burn. Pieces you already own are a little less likely to roll again. Every species except Nakamoto has a ★ signature hat, plus a few other ★ pieces only it can wear (hybrids can wear their parents' ★ pieces, except the hat). Crowns are shared gear any pet can wear. Open a pet's Gear to take pieces off or put them on from your stash or another of your pets. Equipping is free and only saved in this browser. Other people see your pet's gear as it was rolled, not your changes. A pet in the Pet Cemetery can't wear gear.

Fights happen in X Circus Kekimus on Play, in one Challenge card: pick both pets with the picker filters, compare, then burn. Challenge for 172.5 ; the other owner accepts for 172.5 within 144 blocks. Pets must be Juvenile or older and not neglected; one fight per pet per day. The loser gives up one random worn piece (★ pieces never) and gets a black eye for 72 blocks. Title belts are just for show: a pet gets one at 3 wins in a row, and it goes back into the trophy case when the pet loses. No betting. More on fights in the Pet Guide →

Two Adult (or older) pets can breed for 33.75 . If the partner belongs to someone else, its owner accepts within 144 blocks for another 33.75 , and the egg goes to you. The first confirmed request gets the egg. If you both check in, whoever confirms first is the requester. The other burn, with the pets flipped, is the accept: that owner does not get the egg, and their pet carries the requester's best stat. Every pet can breed 6 times in its life, with a one-week wait (1,008 blocks) between breeds. No breeding with a parent, child or sibling. Hybrids also inherit body parts from the other parent, and there are rare twins, mutations and hidden traits. Two different species often give a hybrid ; the same species gives a bonus trait. The baby is an Egg. Feed it 17.25 XCPETS to hatch it. Its hunger clock starts right away. Breeding odds in the Pet Guide →

Discard is one tiny on-chain burn (1 dander plus the Bitcoin fee, however many pets it names). The pets stay yours, but they leave your feeds, the cemetery place lists and the Pepe Wheel, and they can't breed. Show discarded → Restore adds them back with the same tiny burn. If you cancel the burn, the pet is only hidden in this browser. Use Discard on single pets, Discard all Commons , Discard selected or 🧹 Clear the pile . Release ( pet:rel ) was retired at block 974,163: such a burn now only feeds the community pet. Use Discard.

Every XCPETS burn by anyone also feeds the community pet, Homer Pepe . He took FUNTRUMP's place when FUNTRUMP reached Mythic and went to Cold Storage. Feed it directly with 17.25 , 172.5 or 1,725 on Play, or burn 172.5 for a community gear roll . At Mythic it goes into Cold Storage and the next community pet takes its place. Player FUNTRUMPs come from the 1 in 777 egg since FUNTRUMP went to Cold Storage (block 973,365). When Homer Pepe reaches Mythic, that egg hatches Homer Pepes instead, and player Homer Pepes can breed. Everything about community pets in the Pet Guide →

The Ranking page has 8 boards. WAGMI → NGMI is first: daily WAGMI check-in streaks per wallet (burn 1 dander with pet:wagmi once a chain day; Play offers it once right after you connect). Today's first five shows the first 5 wallets to say WAGMI this chain day: each gets +1 saved Pepe Wheel spin and the DAY ONE DEGEN badge. The others rank the most pets, power, rarest collection, top burners, battle wins, Legendary hunters and oldest pets. Below them, NGMI lists wallets with living pets that haven't said WAGMI yet this chain day, biggest streak at risk first.

s.h: Spam City Games: sell, buy, swap and gift pets
s.t: Open 🛒 Spam City . From block 972,729 each pet can have a pet token : a Counterparty asset tied to it. Whoever holds the token owns the pet , wherever the token goes. Sell: make the token (free, Bitcoin fee only), wait 1 block, tie it (1 dander), then list it on the Counterparty DEX for XCPETS or XCP. Buy: one wallet window; the pet and its gear move when the match confirms. Gift: pick pets, paste the friend's Bitcoin address (bc1…, 1… or 3…), Send. That is a token send (several pets = one send). Untokened pets get a token first, automatically. Swap: gift each other, or place a token-for-token DEX order. Check a token: the pet page and xcp.io show it; only the token the game tied counts. From block 972,783: only a pet's first move in a block counts, and tokens sent to a burn address put the pet out of play. Details . One way to tie, from block 972,896: make the token, then tie it with a 1-dander burn. Making a token alone no longer ties it. Pets already tied by making their token before that block stay tied.

Every burn is a Bitcoin transaction, so it costs a small BTC network fee on top of the XCPETS. The game picks the lowest fee rate that should still confirm within about an hour and shows the fee before you approve. A burn takes effect once it's confirmed in a block. Until then it shows under Your burns as pending, and you can tap any burn to see its status and explorer links.

An XCPETS pet is an 8-bit meme character that lives on Bitcoin. You hatch one by burning XCPETS on Counterparty. Each pet comes from a Bitcoin block hash plus its pet id. Anyone can rebuild any pet from those two values and get the exact same pixels. Nobody picks your pet. The block decides.

Pepe : the smug green frog. Any tier. Wojak : the bald feels guy with tired eyes. Any tier. Chud : Wojak's cousin. His clear glasses never come off. Any tier. Peepo : a little frog with huge bulging eyes. Happy one day, sad the next. Any tier. Doge : the shiba. Wow. Any tier. Bobo : the bear. Uncommon and up. Mumu : the bull. Uncommon and up. Sarutobi : the monkey with a tan face and round ears. Uncommon and up. Lenny : the raised-eyebrow face, now a pet. Uncommon and up. Snibby : a yellow crab with tall eyestalks and a big grin. Rare and up. KEVIN : green slit eyes and a flat stare. Rare and up. Dodo : the dark bird with red webbed feet. Legendary only. Nakamoto : always Legendary. Nakamotos are no longer hatched; existing ones are kept. The 1 in 777 egg is now a FUNTRUMP egg. Bitcoin Wizard : the purple-hatted wizard with a grey beard and a Bitcoin staff. Hatches only from the 1 in 777 egg. Egg Wizards are Rare (about 77%) or Legendary (about 23%), never Common or Uncommon; prize Wizards are Legendary. In Cold Storage since block 972,325. Wizard eggs stopped when Lord Kek reached Mythic. From block 972,716 player Bitcoin Wizards breed like any pet: with another species the egg is a Wizard hybrid about 68% of the time, Wizard times Wizard is always a Bitcoin Wizard. The community Wizard never breeds. Lord Kek : the green frog-god in a striped Egyptian nemes headdress (red and gold for player Keks, lapis and gold for the community pet). In Cold Storage since block 972,869. Lord Kek eggs stopped when FUNTRUMP reached Mythic. Player Lord Keks grow and breed like any pet, and their hybrids use the Pepe body. FUNTRUMP (#4) and Homer Pepe (#5) are community pets too, and the White Rabbit (#6) is next: The 1 in 777 egg is now a FUNTRUMP egg. See The community pet and Cold Storage .

Every egg first has a 1 in 777 chance to be a community-pet egg. The 1 in 777 egg is now a FUNTRUMP egg. (It was Nakamoto first, then the Bitcoin Wizard, then Lord Kek; Nakamotos are no longer hatched, existing ones are kept.) When Homer Pepe reaches Mythic and goes to Cold Storage, FUNTRUMP eggs stop and that 1 in 777 egg becomes a Homer Pepe egg. Otherwise the egg rolls a tier. The tier decides: which species it can be a bonus added to every stat which patterns, eyes and gear it can roll Tier Hatch odds Stat bonus Common 60% (about 3 in 5) +0 Uncommon 27% (about 1 in 4) +3 Rare 10% (1 in 10) +6 Legendary 3% (about 1 in 33) +10 ⚡ Electric Eggs (Electric Shock Box, pet:hatchzap , 1,000 eggs, from block 972,992): Common 30%, Uncommon 40%, Rare 22%, Legendary 8%. Species odds inside each tier and the 1 in 777 special egg are the same as a normal egg. Mythic is a stage, not a hatch tier. Full odds Nakamoto eggs were always Legendary. Bitcoin Wizards are Rare or Legendary (from block 972,404): egg Wizards roll Rare (about 77%) or Legendary (about 23%), never Common or Uncommon; prize Wizards are Legendary. From 972,399 to 972,403 every Wizard was Rare.

Every pet has five stats: Vigor, Spark, Grit, Zoom, Luck. Each stat starts at a roll from 1 to 20, plus the tier bonus (Common +0, Uncommon +3, Rare +6, Legendary +10). Stats are set at birth. Higher stages give a pet more HP in battle. Power is all five stats added together.

Your pet's colors always match its species. The extras roll by tier. Rarer tiers unlock rarer options. Patterns Any tier: Plain, Belly patch, Spots Uncommon and up: Stripes, Socks, Bandit mask Rare and up: Checker, Two-tone Legendary only: Galaxy, Rainbow Eyes Any tier: Classic, Sunglasses Uncommon and up: Tinted Rare and up: Star Legendary only: Laser eyes Cheeks (Blush, Freckles, Tear tracks or none), background and a random name also come from the block. Your pet's face changes with each stage.

Egg → Hatchling → Juvenile → Adult → Elder → Mythic You grow your pet by burning XCPETS to feed it. Each meal adds that stage's meal size to its "care". Hatch: 17.25 XCPETS. A hatched pet starts as a Hatchling (69 care). A bred Egg needs a 17.25 meal to hatch. Feed once per day (a day is 144 Bitcoin blocks). A burn below the meal doesn't count, and anything above it only feeds the community pet. Raising a pet to Mythic costs 17,267.25 XCPETS in total. Stage Total care needed Meal (care, burn now) Egg 0 69 ( 17.25 ) Hatchling 69 4,140 ( 1,035 ) Juvenile 8,349 6,900 ( 1,725 ) Adult 22,149 9,660 ( 2,415 ) Elder 41,469 9,200 ( 2,300 ) Mythic 69,069 never needs feeding With one meal a day, a pet reaches Mythic in about 9 days. Meals are capped per stage, so you can't skip ahead. At Mythic your pet is fully fed. It never needs feeding again. Mythic shortcut: once you raise one Mythic pet yourself, Mythic for all your other pets needs only 21,000 care. Raised means you hatched, bred or were granted it and it never left you, or you fed it more than half of its care yourself. Gifted, swapped or bought Mythics don't count, and exactly half isn't enough. Pets already past 21,000 become Mythic right away, even before Elder. Overflow spins: each of those pets also earns one free saved Pepe Wheel spin for every full 1,000 care above 21,000. Don't forget to feed it. Feed at least once every chain day (144 blocks). From the 3rd day after its last meal, a pet is neglected (no battles or breeding). After 7 full days with no meal, it dies and moves to the Pet Cemetery ; its gear goes back to your stash. Mythic pets never starve.

Pets wear gear in six slots: Headwear, Grip, Armor, Drip, Guise, Ride (Ride was called Footwear: skateboards, lily pads and shoes) From block 973,560 every pet has all 6 gear slots open , whatever its age, feeding, tier or stage (new pets too). Before that block a new pet had 1 slot open and more opened with age (2, 5 and 10 days old) and feeding (50% and 80% of days fed), in this order: Headwear, Grip, Armor, Drip, Guise, Ride. Mythic pets already had all 6. Slots never close once open. Get gear by burning 86.25 XCPETS for a roll (a Pepe Wheel spin, below). A roll can land in any of the 6 slots . Before block 973,560 a piece for a slot the pet hadn't opened yet waited in that pet's bag ; at that block every bagged piece is worn (or goes to the stash if that slot is already filled). The community pet always wears community-rolled gear right away (the newest piece replaces that slot). Lucky drops: moving up a stage has a 25% chance to give a free saved Pepe Wheel spin, and a normal meal has a 2% chance. Each slot holds one piece. A piece you replace goes back to your stash. Equipping is free and only saved in this browser. Gear tiers follow the pet's tier: a pet rolls gear up to its own rarity. Signature legendary hats. Every species except Nakamoto has one signature hat, plus a few other ★ signature pieces. Only that species can roll them or wear them (hybrids can wear their parents' ★ pieces, except the hat), they only roll on Legendary pets, and they can never be taken in battle. The Pepe Wheel (live since block 972,589 ): every paid gear roll, pet:spin ( pet:roll:ID is retired from block 974,163), 86.25 XCPETS, (1) picks one of your living, non-community pets that has at least one open slot, at random from the block hash and tx, weighted by tier: Common 1, Uncommon 2, Rare 4, Legendary 8 (so one Legendary is 8 times as likely as one Common); (2) rolls the piece for that pet exactly like a normal roll (any of the 6 slots, its tier cap, ★ only for a Legendary, its species and signature pieces); (3) puts it straight onto that pet if that slot is open (it replaces whatever was in that slot, which goes back to your stash); if the slot is still locked, the piece waits in that pet's bag. If none of your living pets has an open slot, the same weighted pick runs over all your living pets and the piece goes into the picked pet's bag. With no living pet the burn does nothing (the site will not send it). Founder ( pet:fr:ID ) and overflow ( pet:of:ID ) rolls closed at block 972,641 and became saved spins. Rolls before that block are unchanged.

Two Adult (or older) pets can breed. It costs 33.75 XCPETS. If the partner pet belongs to someone else, its owner accepts within 144 blocks for another 33.75 , and the egg goes to you. The first confirmed request gets the egg. The other owner's burn with the pets flipped is the accept: they do not get the egg, and their pet carries the requester's best stat. The baby starts as an Egg with no gear and no care. Feed it 17.25 XCPETS to hatch it. Its hunger clock starts right away. Every pet (Nakamoto too) can breed 6 times in its life, with a one-week wait (1,008 blocks) between breeds. The pet page and the motel picker show breeds used, like 2/6. No inbreeding: a pet can't breed with its parent, its child or a sibling. Hybrid babies also get body parts from the other parent (a Dodo beak, Mumu horns, Bobo ears, a Sarutobi tail and so on). Looks only. Rare surprises: twins (1 in 50: two eggs for one breed), a mutation (1 in 100: half an odd palette, half a glitch look; looks only), a hidden trait that can skip a generation and show up in a grandchild, and Legendary times Legendary hybrids sometimes (1 in 4) get a three-way mix look. Quest Jackpot Eggs (a Legendary Haul on the Cold Storage Vault quest, or a FUNTRUMP Ambush) cross the questing pet with a wild Legendary of another species and roll boosted extras: a mutation 1 in 5, twins 1 in 5, a hidden trait 1 in 3 and, for hybrids, a three-way mix look 1 in 2. The egg has one parent, so it is one generation after that pet. Every pet has a generation: hatched and granted pets are Gen 0, a baby is one more than its older parent (a Jackpot Egg is one more than its one parent). Same species: the baby is the same species and gets one bonus: +3 to a stat (50%), a rarer pattern (30%), or rarer eyes (20%). If the baby already has the best pattern or eyes its tier allows, that bonus becomes +3 to a stat instead. Different species: there's a 68.4773435% chance of a hybrid , a mix of both parents. Otherwise the baby is one parent's species (50/50). Baby stats are about the average of the parents. Baby tier: 5% chance of one tier above the better parent, 30% the better parent's tier, otherwise the lower parent's tier. Hybrids take the better parent's tier, with a 10% chance of one tier up. Hybrid parents: if either parent is a hybrid, the egg is always a hybrid. It can be the same mix, a different mix of the species involved, or a three-way mix when three or more species are in the family. 🧬 Browse every hybrid bred so far →

Fights happen in X Circus Kekimus on Play, in one Challenge card: pick both pets with the picker filters, compare, then burn. Challenge for 172.5 XCPETS; the other owner accepts for 172.5 within 144 blocks. Pets must be Juvenile or older and not neglected; one fight per pet per day. Stats, stage and worn gear decide it, with the block as the dice. The loser gives up one random worn piece to the winner (★ pieces never) and gets a black eye for 72 blocks. Title belts are just for show: a pet gets one at 3 wins in a row, and it goes back into the trophy case when the pet loses. No betting.

Every XCPETS burn by anyone feeds the shared community pet, Homer Pepe , including hatches, feeds, battles and plain burns. He took FUNTRUMP's place when FUNTRUMP reached Mythic. He grows 100 times slower than a normal pet and never starves: he hatched at 69,000 burned and turns Mythic at 6,906,900. Watch it grow on the home page . Feed it directly with 17.25 , 172.5 or 1,725 on Play, or burn 172.5 for a community gear roll. It always wears the newest piece. Community pets stay community pets until they reach Mythic. Then they go into Cold Storage and become real pets anyone can hatch. Player Bitcoin Wizards came from the 1 in 777 egg until Lord Kek went to Cold Storage. From block 972,716 they breed like any pet (135 per breed); the community Bitcoin Wizard in Cold Storage never breeds. Player FUNTRUMPs come from the 1 in 777 egg since FUNTRUMP went to Cold Storage (block 973,365). When Homer Pepe reaches Mythic, that egg hatches Homer Pepes instead, and player Homer Pepes can breed. Before the Wizard, Nakamoto was the community pet until The Return , when the community burned 1,111,111. Read his story in Cold Storage .

Discard is free: no burn, no wallet. It only hides the pet in this browser, and you can restore it any time from Show discarded in My Pets. Release is a tiny on-chain burn (0.00000001) that gives the pet up for good, for everyone. Its gear goes back to your stash. A pet that dies moves to the Pet Cemetery , and its gear goes back to its owner's stash.
A burn that doesn't do what you meant (wrong amount, wrong pet, too early) still burns, and only feeds the community pet. Check before you send.

← Back to the game · Rules in short XCPETS is a Counterparty token on Bitcoin. You play by burning (destroying) XCPETS with a short text tag. Every burn is a normal Bitcoin transaction: you review and sign it in your own wallet (XCP Wallet), and you also pay a small Bitcoin network fee each time. Burned tokens are gone for good. The game state is rebuilt by anyone from the public chain: same burns, same result, no server.

s.h: Spam City Games: pet tokens (from block 972,729)
s.t: The token is the pet. A pet token is a free numeric Counterparty asset (1 unit, indivisible, locked, description https://xcpets.fun/t/ID.json ). Making one costs no XCPETS (only the Bitcoin fee). A 1-dander burn pet:deed:ID:<asset> by the pet's owner, at least 1 block after the token is made, ties it to the pet. From block 972,729, whoever holds a tied pet's token owns the pet: Counterparty sends, multi-asset (MPMA) sends, DEX fills, dispensers, any transfer. Worn and bag gear move with the pet. Only the token whose tie burn the game accepted counts; look-alike tokens with the same description are ignored. Gift = send the token (🎁 Gift: pick pets, paste a Bitcoin address, Send). Several tokens go in one MPMA send (up to 10 per transaction). A pet without a token gets one made and tied first in the same flow. Sell = a DEX order that gives the token for an exact amount of XCPETS (at least 1) or XCP (at least 1,000 sats), 288 blocks. Buy = the matching order. A completed match moves the pet. pet:unsell:<tx8> (1 dander) ends a listing 6 blocks later. Swap = two gifts, or one token-for-token DEX order. A destroyed token unties its pet (the pet stays with the last holder and can get a new token). A new token tied by the owner replaces the old one; the old one then means nothing. Cemetery: raising a grave unties its old token (it stays a keepsake and can no longer move the pet). From block 973,859, a successful Resurrection also unties any token still tied to the pet: the pet stays with the wallet that resurrected it, and that owner can make a new token and tie it with a normal pet:deed burn. New rules, from block 972,783: 1) Sending a token to a burn address is allowed: the pet then belongs to that burn address, is out of play for good (nobody can use it) and the site shows it as sent to a burn address. 2) One move per pet per block: only the first move of a pet's token in block order counts; later moves of it in the same block are ignored (the token still moves on Counterparty but the pet stays with the first receiver until the token moves again). 3) Making a token ties it: a token made by the pet's owner (first issuance, 1 unit, locked, description https://xcpets.fun/t/ID.json ) is tied to pet #ID when it confirms, with no tie burn. Tokens made by anyone else are ignored, and a pet that already has a token keeps it (replace it with the pet:deed burn). Tie burns made before the gate by owners who still hold the token count at the gate. One way to tie, from block 972,896: there is only one way to give a pet a token: make the token (first issuance by the pet's owner, 1 unit, locked, description https://xcpets.fun/t/ID.json ), then tie it with a pet:deed:ID:… burn (1 dander). From this block, making a token alone does not tie it (rule 3 above ends). Pets already tied by making their token before this block stay tied.

The Electric Shock Box is one pet:hatchzap burn of 100,000 XCPETS (the halving and Fire Sales apply like every hatch, so 50,000 after halving 1 and 25,000 after halving 2) that hatches 1,000 Electric Eggs . Every Electric Egg still has the same 1 in 777 chance of the special egg. Otherwise it rolls its tier on the Electric ladder below instead of the normal one. Its species is then picked from that tier exactly like a normal egg (same species odds inside each tier), and its looks are rolled the normal way. Tier Normal egg Electric Egg Stat bonus Common 60% 30% +0 Uncommon 27% 40% +3 Rare 10% 22% +6 Legendary 3% 8% +10 Rare is 2.2 times as likely and Legendary 2.67 times as likely per egg. A box gives about 300 Common, 400 Uncommon, 220 Rare and 80 Legendary pets. The same XCPETS spent on Yolk Booster Boxes hatches about 2,087 eggs: about 1,252 Common, 564 Uncommon, 209 Rare and 63 Legendary. So the Electric Shock Box gives fewer pets in total, a few more Rares and about 28% more Legendaries, with far fewer Commons to feed. Mythic is a stage pets grow into by being fed, not a hatch tier , so no egg (Electric or not) hatches Mythic.

Egg → Hatchling (69, i.e. hatching) → Juvenile (8,349) → Adult (22,149) → Elder (41,469) → Mythic (69,069 care, reached automatically by feeding; there is no Evolve burn): a 69 hatch plus 9 meals (2 / 2 / 2 / 3 per stage), one meal a day: Juvenile day 2, Adult day 4, Elder day 6, Mythic day 9. Mythic shortcut : once you raise a Mythic pet yourself, Mythic for all your pets needs only 21,000 care. Raised means you hatched, bred or were granted it and it never left you, or you added more than half of its care yourself (care you add counts from the day you get the pet, and starts again at 0 if it changes owner). A Mythic you were gifted, swapped for or bought doesn't count, and neither does a pet you got close to Mythic and fed once; exactly half isn't enough. Pets already at 21,000 or more become Mythic right away, even before Elder. From block 973,755 pets on the 21,000 Mythic line no longer skip stages: they grow faster instead, with Juvenile at 2,538, Adult at 6,734 and Elder at 12,608 (the same cut as Mythic). Meals, care and the 21,000 Mythic line stay the same; only the stage your pet shows moves. Care you've already burned is kept as it is, and each of those pets gets 1 free saved spin for every full 1,000 care above 21,000 (these were overflow rolls until block 972,641). Community pet: every burn counts toward it. It hatches at 69,000 XCPETS and grows 100 times slower than a regular pet (Mythic at 6,906,900). Community pets stay community pets until they reach Mythic. Then they go into Cold Storage and become real pets anyone can hatch. The Bitcoin Wizard reached Mythic at block 972,325; Lord Kek reached Mythic at block 972,869; FUNTRUMP reached Mythic at block 973,365; Homer Pepe took that place and is the community pet now. Player Bitcoin Wizards and Lord Keks breed like any pet (the community pets themselves never breed). Homer Pepe's signature gear is the pink sprinkle donut. The White Rabbit (#6) took Homer Pepe's place when Homer Pepe reached Mythic (block 974,841); his signature gear is a gold pocket watch. More in the Pet Guide .

From block 977,026, a pet that has been dead for 14 game days leaves the game. A game day is 144 Bitcoin blocks. The pause from block 975,817 to 976,518 does not count. Pets already past those 14 days when the rule turned on left at that block. These pets stay. A Rare tier is not enough, and a normal species is not kept for its species. Legendary pets, and Mythic pets. Rare species : Nakamoto, Bitcoin Wizard, Lord Kek, FUNTRUMP, Homer Pepe, the White Rabbit, DJ Pepe, Viking, Old Hickory Pepe, the Orange Dragon, Bo Jackson, Rarepigeon, Bo Pigeon, and the contest pets (Star-Lord Kek, Gooby, and Luke Spam Junior). Pepe, Wojak, and the rest of the everyday hatch list, including Chad, are not on this list. Hybrids , including a three-way hybrid. Special pets : 1 of 1s, contest prizes, burn lords, grant pets, a pet tied to its own token, a keepsake, a jackpot pet, and a Legend hatch (a DJ Pepe, Wizard, Lord Kek, or God egg). Weird hatches : tiny, giant, two-headed, inverted, ghost, backwards, and wrong egg. An Electric Egg is not kept just because it came from an Electric Shock Box. If that pet is also Legendary, Mythic, a rare species, a hybrid, special, or weird, that other reason still keeps it. The community pet stays. A burn aimed at a pet that has left only feeds the community pet. This site will not ask you to sign that burn. Gear on a pet that leaves goes back to the owner's stash.

Free gear now comes as saved spins for the Pepe Wheel. You earn one from a lucky drop (25% each time a pet moves up a stage, 2% per meal), from a burn at the usual amount during a Fire Sale, and from Mythic overflow (one per 1,000 care over 21,000). Unused founder free rolls and overflow rolls were turned into saved spins. Spins never expire. Use them in the Rare Room: one tiny burn spends up to 10 spins and costs only the Bitcoin fee. From block 973,484 one tiny burn can use all your saved spins at once ( pet:usespin:all ), still only the Bitcoin fee. Pieces go on your pets' open slots first; the rest land in bags or the stash (before block 973,560 a piece for a still-locked slot waited in that pet's bag; from that block every slot is open). Before block 974,279 each saved spin picked a random living pet of yours, just like a paid spin: that included pets you never fed and pets you discarded (Discard only hides a pet in your browser; the chain still counts it). From block 974,279 saved spins land only on pets you pick: use Pick pets for your spins in the Rare Room (see the block list below). The Join us sign and the LORDKEK card stay special keepsakes.

When STAR LORD KEK defeated Lord Kek (the burn that brought Lord Kek to Mythic), Lord Kek went to Cold Storage and, 6 blocks later (block 972,875), every burn cost half : hatching, meals, gear spins, fights, breeding, community rolls and community feeding (the 69 / 690 / 6,900 choices and the minimum, based on the original amounts). After that, each time a community pet goes to Cold Storage the next community pet takes its place and burns cost half again exactly once, 6 blocks after that Cold Storage block (FUNTRUMP going to Cold Storage started halving 2 at block 973,371). A new pet arriving adds no halving. Halvings so far: 2. The next one comes 6 blocks after Homer Pepe goes to Cold Storage. Care never changes: a meal gives the same care as before and just costs half, so every pet grows at the same pace. Amounts can have decimals (XCPETS has 8 decimal places).

Now and then a lucky block calls a Fire Sale . Captain Dan yells a warning first; 6 blocks later the sale is live for 36 blocks. During a sale every burn costs 31% of the usual amount : hatching, meals, gear spins, fights, breeding, community rolls and community feeding, including the 69 / 690 / 6,900 choices and the minimum. It stacks on the halving: after a halving the halved amount drops again to 31% of itself. Amounts go to 8 decimal places (0.00000001 XCPETS), rounded to the nearest one, and a burn must be at least that amount.

From block 972,897, Bitcoin Wizard, Lord Kek and FUNTRUMP eggs (and FUNTRUMP babies) get a normal random pet name, like every other egg, instead of "Wizard", "Kek" or "FUNTRUMP". The first Lord Kek egg ever hatched (#22475) keeps the name Kek, and pets hatched before this block keep their names.
Eye types include Sunglasses (formerly Beady). Cheeks: Blush, None, Freckles or Tear tracks. Blush 35% / None 45% / Freckles 10% / Tear tracks 10%.

Randomness comes only from Bitcoin block hashes and transaction ids. Burns count in chain order. A burn that breaks a rule is never refunded, but it still feeds the community pet. Burns count once they are confirmed in a block and the Counterparty node has read them. Every Bitcoin transaction pays a network fee (often a few cents, more when the network is busy), so every meal costs BTC too.

From block 973,002 a pet can earn looks by what it does. Everything is worked out from the chain, so every player sees the same result. An earned look stays with the pet for good, also when the pet changes hands, until block 973,013; from then on it is held by the wallet (see Choose your looks ). Wallet flame looks (Kindling, Wildfire, Satoshi Sun) and quest looks work exactly as before, and nobody loses a look they already have. Laurels: win 10 duels while Mythic, or win 5 duels in a row (any stage; a loss starts the count again). Halo: finish 10 Mythic quests (any result; quests finished before this block count). Holo foil: tie the pet to a pet token (Proof of Pet). Pets already tied get it at this block. Crown: be #1 on the Power board (Vigor + Spark + Grit + Zoom + Luck, ties go to the lowest pet number) at 7 daily checks in a row (7 times 144 blocks = 1,008 blocks, about a week). Wings: keep a Mythic alive for 4,032 blocks (about 4 weeks), counted from this block or from the day it reached Mythic, whichever is later. Flame aura: burn 69,000 XCPETS on that pet's own actions (meals, gear spins, quests and so on, from this block). The 6,900 and 690,000 milestones are recorded too. A pet shows one look of each kind (top piece, foil, back piece, aura). Looks it already shows from wallet flame tiers or quests come first.

s.h: Flex Forge : choose your looks (from block 973,013)
s.t: From block 973,013 you decorate your pet cards: you choose which looks show on which of your pets. Every look your wallet owns can go on any living pet your wallet owns (not in Cold Storage): wallet flame looks (Kindling, Wildfire, Satoshi Sun), quest looks and earned looks. Use the Flex Forge on a pet page (Forge it on / Take off), the Flex Forge Station in The Rare Room, or see which card wears each look in My Flex under My Pets (Move it sends a look to another pet in one burn). How: the pet's owner burns the smallest amount (0.00000001 XCPETS) with the memo pet:look:ID:CODE:on or pet:look:ID:CODE:off . One burn can carry up to 6 changes for one pet, for example pet:look:12:KL:on:QN:off . Only the owner of pet ID can change it. Flame looks keep their limits: each flame look goes on 1 pet at a time (putting it on another pet moves it there), or on up to 3 pets for early burners (take it off one first to use a 4th). You need to have reached the flame tier of the look. Quest and earned looks are one copy each, held by the wallet that owned the pet when it got the look. Putting a copy on another pet moves it there. A pet gets each quest or earned look once, so the copies come from different pets: two pets that each earned Halo give you two Halo copies. Selling or giving a pet away (from block 973,644: sales, gifts, swaps and token moves): its looks stay on the pet. The quest and earned copies on it go to the new owner; the flame looks on it stay on it too, and you keep your flame tier for your other pets. Before block 973,644 all its looks came off that pet and stayed with the old owner's wallet. One look per spot shows on each pet: head (Laurels, Halo, crowns), back (wings, Aurora backdrop), skin (Galaxy skin), foil (the holo foils) and aura (Flame aura, Lightning aura, Neon Trail, Spell Sparkles). Putting on a new one in the same spot takes the old one off that pet. A skin and a foil can show together. If the pet is not yours, or is dead, released or in Cold Storage, the whole burn fails. A change that fails its own check (look not owned, flame tier not reached, limit reached, already on or not on that pet) is skipped; the rest of the burn still counts. If no change in the burn works, it becomes community food. Burns with this memo before block 973,013 are community food too. pet:aura:ID:on and pet:aura:ID:off kept working until block 974,163; from that block pet:aura is retired (community food): use pet:look . Codes. Flame: KL Laurels, KA Flame aura, WH Halo, WR Rainbow holo, WL Lightning aura, SC Gold-foil crown, SW Holo wings, SG Galaxy skin. Quest: QN Neon Trail, QA Aurora backdrop, QB Black holo, QS Spell Sparkles, QG Gold holo. Earned: EL Laurels, EH Halo, EF Holo foil, EC Crown, EW Wings, EA Flame aura.

s.h: 🌕 Mythic Gods and the Pantheon (from block 974,074)
s.t: From block 974,074 a starving zombie can be unleashed on its owner's own Mythics. Everything is worked out from the chain, so every player sees the same result. See the Pantheon . Unleash: burn 86.25 XCPETS (690 base; the halvings and Fire Sales apply) with the memo pet:unleash:ZOMBIE_ID from the zombie's owner. The zombie must be your own feral zombie and must not crumble before the meal. One unleash per wallet every 4,320 blocks (30 days). Blocked once all 21 Pantheon seats are full. A rejected burn uses nothing up. The meal: 6 blocks after the burn the zombie eats one of your Mythics at random (picked from the meal block hash). Only a Mythic you have held for 30 days (4,320 blocks) can be eaten. Never eaten: 1 of 1 and edition pets, the owner's pets #1, #2 and #13, community pets, tokenized pets, pets listed in the shop, pets in Cold Storage, away on a quest or in an open fight, and Gods. If nothing can be eaten at the meal block, the meal is cancelled. Mythic-fed zombie: gets 30% of the eaten Mythic's stats, never goes feral and never crumbles. Mythic grave: the eaten Mythic leaves a violet grave. Anyone can raise it with one Legendary (or better) offering; the raiser owns the Mythic zombie. Mythic God: a Resurrection on a Mythic zombie needs 66 points. One try: a win makes a Mythic God (its Mythic stats plus 25%, never dies, Moon Ward: the first battle loss each day keeps its gear, breeding cooldown 2 times) with a seat in the Pantheon; a fail turns it to dust. 21 seats ever, one Mythic God per wallet every 30 days. Gods only breed with Gods (from block 973,982): a resurrected pet (a God; every Mythic God is one) can only breed with another resurrected pet, and a pet that is not resurrected can't breed with a God. The site won't send a mixed breed or Rug Me, the replay rejects one, and the breed pickers only show mates that fit. God looks: resurrected pets (Gods) and God-born babies shine (display only, no stat effect).

Every 1,008 blocks (about a week) a Raid Boss appears, starting at block 973,010. Each raid lasts 432 blocks (about 3 days). Everyone burns together to bring it down. Everything is worked out from the chain, so every player sees the same result. Which boss: the hash of the block that opens the raid picks one of 13 bosses. When a raid window holds a block whose height ends in 2140, the event boss Lord Blockschild shows up instead. Boss HP: fixed for each boss: The Night Shift Grinner 420,000; Night King 600,000; Grim Reaper 666,000; Baron Von Burnschild, The All-Seeing Kek and Necrofrog the Undying 690,000; The Grinning Colossus 750,000; Infernal Frogfather 777,000; Dragonkek 800,000; Dark Pepe the Endless Coil 840,000; Moloch 900,000 (Lord Kek vs Moloch: every hit helps Lord Kek strike him); The Tower of Terrors 999,000; Titan 1,000,000; Lord Blockschild (event) 2,140,000. Attack: burn at least 17.25 XCPETS (69 base; the halvings and Fire Sales apply) with the memo pet:raid:ID from the pet's owner. The pet must be hatched, alive, not neglected, not away on a quest and not in Cold Storage. One attack per pet per chain day (144 blocks). Damage = burn amount times the pet multiplier times the crit roll. The pet multiplier is 1.00 plus a stage bonus (Hatchling 0, Juvenile 0.10, Adult 0.20, Elder 0.30, Mythic 0.40) plus a rarity bonus (Common 0, Uncommon 0.03, Rare 0.06, Legendary 0.10), so from 1.00 up to 1.50. The crit roll comes from the burn's transaction id: 3 times (mega crit) 5% of the time, 2 times (crit) 20% of the time, otherwise 1 time. Damage is rounded down. Killing blow: the attack that takes the boss to 0 HP wins the raid; damage past 0 does not count. After that, attacks on that raid are turned down (community food). If the boss still has HP when the raid ends, it escapes and nobody gets a reward. Rewards (only when the boss falls): every pet that attacked gets the RAIDER badge; the top 3 pets by damage get the 🥇 🥈 🥉 trophies (ties go to the pet that hit first); the pet that landed the killing blow gets the 🗡️ Killing Blow trophy; and one lucky drop (a 🍀 Boss Relic plus 3 saved Pepe Wheel spins for its owner) goes to one attacking pet, picked by the hash of the kill block, with odds in line with the damage each pet dealt. There is no Gold holo reward. Confirmations: results count 6 blocks after the kill (or after the raid ends), so a short chain reorg cannot change them.

A quest jackpot egg is a free egg a Mythic can bring home from a quest. Everything is worked out from the chain, so every player sees the same result. The egg goes to whoever holds the Mythic at Homecoming. How you get one: a Legendary Haul on the Cold Storage Vault quest ( pet:quest:ID:cold ), or a FUNTRUMP Ambush on any quest: 1 in 69, or 2 in 69 on FUNTRUMP's own quests, and none while a FUNTRUMP pet is away on a quest. What hatches: a hybrid baby of your Mythic and a wild Legendary of another species (never Nakamoto, the Bitcoin Wizard, Lord Kek or FUNTRUMP, and never a species already in your pet's hybrid mix). It has one parent on the chain, your Mythic, and its generation is one more than that parent's. Odds on a jackpot egg: mutation 1 in 5 (then 50/50: an Odd palette or a Glitch look; looks only, no effect on stats, fights or breeding), twins 1 in 5 , a hidden trait 1 in 3 and a Legendary three-way mix look 1 in 2 . A bred baby mutates only 1 in 100. A child, not a breed: from block 974,435 a jackpot egg counts as a child of its parent (its family tree and its Breedings line; twins count once, like bred twins; jackpot eggs from before that block count too). From block 974,478 it does not use any of the parent's 6 lifetime breeds . It never starts a breeding cooldown and still comes when the parent has used all its breeds. Lifetime breeds that jackpot eggs used from block 974,435 are given back at block 974,478, so no jackpot egg ever counts against the 6.

From block 974,485 a quest brings home Power Shards . Each shard is +1 to one of the quest's two stats, for good . Everything is worked out from the chain, so every player sees the same result. What a quest brings: Spam City Run: Haul 2, Loot 1 (Zoom or Luck). Cold Storage Vault: Haul 3, Loot 1 (Grit or Vigor). Lord Kek's Swamp: Haul 4, Loot 2 (Spark or Luck). The Wizard's Tower: Haul 5, Loot 2 (Spark or Zoom). Burning Mines: Haul 6, Loot 3 (Grit or Vigor). Came Home Empty brings none. The other prizes (gear, saved spins, jackpot eggs, the FUNTRUMP Ambush) stay as they are, except that a Cold Storage Vault Loot now brings 1 shard instead of a saved spin. Where the points go: each point goes to whichever of the quest's two stats has fewer shards, so they spread across both. A tie is settled by the block hash. Limits: up to 15 shard points per pet (stat gains from Legendary Hauls before this block count toward the 15) and 8 in one stat . Once a pet is full, quests still bring every other prize. The old +1 stat on a Legendary Haul stops at this block; gains a pet already has stay. Breeding (half strength): each parent counts half of its shard points, rounded down , stat by stat, and the egg's stats are worked out the normal way. What the egg gets above its plain breed result becomes the egg's own shard points : they count inside its own limit of 15 (8 in one stat) and are halved again when it breeds. So shard points can never grow from one generation to the next: no pet ever carries more than 15. Twins share the same shard points. A quest jackpot egg's wild parent copies its Mythic's stats, shard points included, so a jackpot egg gets the Mythic's shard points at half strength from both sides. Where you see them: pet cards show 💠 next to each stat that has shard points and the total under TOTAL; the Power ranking shows each pet's shard points.
